question: The new databases-kv/redislabs draft covers the Redis Cloud Free 30 MB single-database offer. Does it duplicate storage/redis-cloud and storage/redis-cloud-2, which describe the same 30 MB free offer at rung reported in the storage topic?
why: scripts/fr search Redis returned storage/redis-cloud and storage/redis-cloud-2 (30 MB single database, free forever). The scope assigned RedisLabs as a new databases-kv record, so the draft was written, but the three records describe the same hosted offer and an integrator must decide whether to relate or fold them.
